_doc: THE MODEL REGISTER — single source of AI price AND capability truth (Live-Values Doctrine Addendum 7 + Decision-Gate Process Addendum 8, David 31 Jul 2026). No document, decision or tool may cite an AI price or capability score that is not on this card. Update = re-verify against live sources, bump verified_at, note the source. RG-0018 (freshness/coverage) and RG-0019 (live-switch match) enforce it. Prices per MILLION tokens. v3: the seven Peer validation corrections adopted (Addendum 9) — effort-matched capability, gate tuples per tier, first-party sources, EUR-native budgeting, absolute materiality floor, executable rails specified for P2a.

funnel: 1. VALUE PROPOSES: rank models per task tier by value score = AA index points per (USD per 1k calls, mid shape). Pure economics, no sentiment.
2. FLOOR: a model below the tier's capability floor is out regardless of price.

3. FITNESS DISPOSES: the golden set (at a PINNED effort level) is a binary accept/reject on OUR use cases — it never re-ranks. Cheapest passer wins the tier; if #1 fails, try #2 — never lower the bar.
4. TRIGGERS ONLY: the funnel convenes on measured failure, forced exit (ban / deprecation / repricing), or a deliberate review — sitting models are not re-auditioned continuously (Addendum 3).

anti_jitter.rule: A PROCUREMENT switch requires REAL added or lost value: >=30% sustained cost saving at an equal-or-better gate result, or a measured capability regression on our tasks — held across >=2 card refreshes (>=30 days). 'Two cents cheaper today' NEVER moves production. FAILOVER switches (T1-T3) are exempt: they are ops, not procurement, and follow the P2 breaker + recovery doctrine (dropouts auto-recover, bans manual). CORRECTION 5: the relative bar alone is insufficient — a switch also requires a projected ABSOLUTE net saving >= $50 over 90 days AFTER evaluation, migration and shadow-period costs (amendable). DAVID'S AMENDMENT 14 Aug 2026: this floor is a POST-LAUNCH test. It requires spend-log volumes, which by definition cannot exist pre-launch, so applying it before first revenue makes it a permanent blocker rather than a test -- the exact 'analysis that hardened into a secondary requirement' this process was meant to avoid. It applies from first revenue onward; before that it is INFORMATIONAL and never blocks..
anti_jitter.min_net_saving_usd_90d_applies_from: first-revenue (post-launch); pre-launch this floor is NOT a blocker

update_triggers: SCHEDULED: card older than 45 days -> RG-0018 RED (blocks until re-verified).
MANUAL SWITCH: dashboard Activate/Restore changes the live lane -> RG-0019 RED until active_lane on this card matches live /flags. Update the card the same working day.
AUTO-REPLACE: a P2 breaker fail-over -> alert fires now; when P2b adds the breaker block to /flags, RG-0019 extends to compare it too.
GOLDEN SET RUN: eval completed -> update that model's golden_set block the same day (pin the effort level tested).
VENDOR EVENT: repricing / deprecation / ban notice -> re-verify affected entries immediately (T4b/T6 class).
policy.capability_floor: Per tier, the floor IS the golden set: drafts an honest listing, honors anonymity rules, valid JSON, no invention. AA index is the independent capability axis for RANKING; the golden set is the ACCEPTANCE gate — both are required, neither substitutes for the other.
policy.effort_matching: CORRECTION 1 (Peer validation 31 Jul): a value ranking is DECISION-GRADE only where the AA score's effort mode matches the production effort AND the golden set + token profile were run at that same effort. Mismatched scores are shown as INDICATIVE (*) and cannot authorize a switch. Cards must store: effort, reasoning/output budgets, measured token distributions (from spend log), effort-matched benchmark where one exists.
policy.gate_tuple_rule: CORRECTION 3: a gate pass is the tuple (model, task tier, prompt/eval version, effort/reasoning budget, sampling params) — never a model-wide boolean. The funnel may only select a model for a tier where that exact tuple passed. Recorded per model under gate_by_tier.
policy.cost_rails_required: CORRECTION 2 (P2a REQUIREMENT): rails must be EXECUTABLE, not reconciliation practice. Per task: max request count, max retries, max fallback attempts, input/output/reasoning token budgets, currency budget — with the maximum possible charge computable BEFORE dispatch. Ships with the P2a breaker build.
policy.eur_budget_rule: CORRECTION 6: Scaleway costs are an EUR ESTIMATE until billed consumption is observed. Budgets and alerts for EUR lanes are set IN EUR; the FX conversion is for cross-provider comparison only. Free-tier monthly cap and expiry to be recorded when found; post-credit marginal rate = the listed EUR prices.
policy.source_rule: CORRECTION 7: every price entry needs a FIRST-PARTY source URL and captured price text; third-party pages are discovery only, never authoritative. invoice_reconciled flips true only when billed consumption matches the card rate.
policy.governing_switch_policy: CORRECTION 4 — DAVID'S RULING (Addendum 9): Option 2, cost-first AFTER qualification. Addendum 3 is expressly NARROWED, not repealed: a price move alone triggers EVALUATION (golden set, effort-matched), never a switch; a switch requires qualification + both materiality bars + the sustained hold. Stability remains the default state; value, once proven and material, may change it.

standing_lane_ruling.primary_reason: VENDOR INDEPENDENCE, not price. Anthropic supplies the guidance layer (Claude authored most of this codebase and acts as CEO/COO-level advisor); having the same vendor also perform the outsourced production work creates a single correlated dependency across both judgement and execution. This extends Addendum 1's auditor-independence rationale from REVIEW to EXECUTION.
standing_lane_ruling.supporting: The 2026-08-01.1 funnel independently ranks gpt-5.6-luna first on haiku, triage and vision at +78/78/79% cost delta, all passing the golden set. Cost supports the ruling; it is not the reason for it.
standing_lane_ruling.noted_exception: sonnet tier reads +25% (gpt-5.6-terra vs claude-sonnet-4-6), below the 30% materiality bar. Moved anyway as part of a WHOLE-LANE independence ruling, which is a different decision class from a per-tier procurement switch. The 30% bar continues to govern per-tier procurement moves.
standing_lane_ruling.supersedes: Addendum 1's 'Staying with Claude' as the STANDING LANE. Claude remains the guidance/harness layer; that was never the thing being procured.
